description: On a typical suburban street in Florissant, Missouri, where campaign signs dot well-kept lawns and the hum of daily life blends with the rhythms of election season, a young candidate is making waves not just for his platform but for his story. Brandon Wilke, a former HVAC technician and the youngest candidate for Missouri House District 75, embodies a unique form of perseverance in politics that draws from real, hard-earned life experience.
